note: Deterministic classification of KNOWN test outcomes so the gate engine can distinguish genuine failure from expected/stale/unavailable. A test NOT listed here defaults to GENUINE (fail-closed: an unexpected failure is treated as real).

categories.STALE_EXPECTATION: Assertion encodes a superseded world-state (e.g. registry now records a verified deployment). Not a system defect. Recommended: fix the assertion in a separate certification-hygiene change.
categories.ENV_GATED: Requires infrastructure absent in this workspace (live HTTP server, MongoDB, operator RPC). Not a defect. Runs on VPS/CI.
categories.UNAVAILABLE_DEPENDENCY: Requires an external dependency or artifact not present (e.g. forge fork RPC, broadcast artifact).
categories.DEPRECATED_PATH: Exercises an intentionally-removed/guarded code path; requires test retirement/replacement.
categories.GENUINE_FAILURE: A real defect or true production blocker. Must be fixed.
categories.PRODUCTION_BLOCKER: A genuine failure that additionally blocks live progression.
